variable_definition: Sinyi housing price index, Taiwan aggregate (台灣), not a city index or an average of cities. All valid observations cross-checked against taiwan_hpi_national_quarterly_raw.csv; the duplicate file is not counted twice. Publisher identifies a hedonic index of residential transactions, excluding presales. Nominal: the index is built from transaction prices with no inflation adjustment, and a central bank study uses a separately deflated 'real Sinyi index'; the pipeline deflates it with Taiwan CPI. Not seasonally adjusted, unlike OECD AnaHPI; quarter-of-year growth differences are not significant (F = 1.24, p = 0.3, 2001-2025), so no adjustment is applied. No added history before 2001Q1 and no filled 2025Q4 value. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
source: data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_hpi_quarterly_raw.csv; data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_hpi_national_quarterly_raw.csv (cross-check); Sinyi Realty / NCCU Sinyi Real Estate Research and Development Center; publisher methodology and history: https://www.sinyinews.com.tw/quarterly; matching 2025Q3 Taiwan and city values: https://www.sinyi.com.tw/expertise/house-price-index/40; real Sinyi index in CBC Quarterly vol. 37 no. 3: https://www.cbc.gov.tw/public/Attachment/5111316213471.pdf
publication_lag: Partially verified: dated NCCU/Sinyi notices establish 2025Q2 available by 2025-07-21 (21 calendar days after quarter-end); 2025Q3 available by 2025-10-27 (27 calendar days after quarter-end). These are availability-by bounds, not verified earliest Sinyi release dates or a fixed historical schedule. Later article/update timestamps are not used as first-release dates.

transformation: Year-over-year percentage change (derived from raw index levels)
variable_definition: Monthly CPI growth = (CPI index this month / CPI index same month one year earlier - 1) * 100. Coverage counts months with both actual finite inputs and a positive year-earlier index; no filling, monthly aggregation or scaling. Original index coverage: 801 valid months, 1959-01–2025-09. Annual Index column excluded. The September 2025 and September 2024 levels (109.82 and 108.46) match DGBAS headline CPI, base 2021=100. This verifies the series match for that example, not every historical value or vintage. Seasonal adjustment is not documented in the CSV. Rates are calculated from supplied rounded levels, not directly reported YoY figures; later revisions/rebasing may change historical inputs. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
source: data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_cpi_monthly_raw.csv; DGBAS headline CPI (2021=100); September 2024/2025 levels matched to Price Statistics Monthly: https://ws.dgbas.gov.tw/001/Upload/464/relfile/10862/235361/pricebook.pdf; dated September 2025 release: https://www.stat.gov.tw/News_Content.aspx?n=3703&s=235357
publication_lag: DGBAS schedule: 5 working days after month-end, adjusted for Lunar New Year, long holidays or special circumstances. This is not 5 calendar days. Verified example: September 2025 -> 2025-10-08 (8 calendar days). The two index inputs match DGBAS; derived YoY rounds to its reported 1.25%. Historical first-release dates for every exact input vintage remain unverified; revised or rebased historical values cannot be assumed available at first release.

variable_definition: GDP growth; raw feature gdp_growth_qoq, supplied directly as quarterly percentage changes; source adjustment: Seasonally adjusted. No conversion from YoY, annualisation/deannualisation, filling or scaling performed. The blank 1982Q1 cell is excluded from coverage. Price basis (real/nominal), annualisation convention, original publisher/table identifier and release vintage are not documented in the new CSV; equivalence to the OECD definitions is not fully established. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
source: data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_gdp_growth_qoq_raw.csv; upstream-supplied QoQ series; original statistical publisher/table not verified
publication_lag: Not verified for the supplied seasonally adjusted QoQ series. Original publisher/table and release-vintage fields are absent. The removed YoY series' dated release examples are not transferred to this file.

transformation: Ratio to GDP (derived from raw inputs)
variable_definition: Consumer-credit balance in the quarter's final month / total nominal GDP for that quarter and the previous three quarters * 100; both inputs NT$ million. Coverage and complete_quarters count quarters with all required raw inputs, not directly reported ratios. Consumer credit may differ from BIS total household/NPISH credit; no monthly filling or averaging. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
source: data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_household_credit_raw.csv; CBC consumer-loan subtotal (447 valid balances matched): https://data.gov.tw/dataset/6549; DGBAS nominal GDP: https://eng.stat.gov.tw/News_Content.aspx?n=2317&s=235721; data/raw/taiwan/taiwan_nominal_gdp_raw.csv; ratio calculated locally
publication_lag: Partially verified: September 2025 consumer credit was released 2025-10-27 (27 calendar days after quarter-end). Credit/GDP must wait until both the quarter-end credit balance and all four nominal-GDP quarters are available. The first availability date of the exact GDP input vintage in this file is not verified; 27 days must not be used as the ratio's lag. No constant historical lag established.

variable_definition: 10-year government bond secondary-market yield; monthly weighted average, remaining maturity close to ten years. All 359 valid raw observations match CBC open-data table EG43M01, column 十年期政府公債次級市場利率(%). CBC compiles this series using Taipei Exchange data; not a policy rate. Common availability uses five countries and measures period coverage, not definition equivalence.
publication_lag: About 23 calendar days after month-end: CBC's published monthly bond-rate schedule (2026 metadata). Saturday releases move to Friday; Sunday/holiday releases move to the next business day. Historical first-release dates have not been verified for every observation.
